NN-1: replace the static detail-header <h2 class='browse-detail__title'> (render.ts:350-353) with an always-editable <input> (keep the class for caret-safe node-identity selectors); commit-on-blur/Enter, Escape reverts, dirty-check + committing guard, allow empty title; renderNoteDetail gains onTitleSave param; the controller's onTitleSave does a defensive editorHandle.flush() then editNote(id,{title}) then a TARGETED list-row DOM update (mirror onSave 531-539) and NEVER calls renderNoteDetail / touches editorHandle (caret-safe; EditorView + .cm-editor identity preserved). edit_note keeps the ULID on rename (ops/notes.rs:117-128) so body autosave still routes by id. ''}) -> loadList({folder:currentFolder}) -> loadDetail(newId) -> focus+select the title input. context_delta.summary: Decision-ready dual-format spec. FRONTEND-ONLY; reuses create_note + edit_note (no Rust). Two stories: NN-1 inline-editable title (+rename any note, caret-safe), NN-2 sidebar New Note (create-in-target-folder + open + focus). Owner-locked decisions resolved: D-BUTTON-PLACEMENT (list-pane compose header, square-pen), D-DEFAULT-TITLE (empty '' — backend-safe via slugify=untitled), D-TITLE-COMPONENT (styled <input>, keep .browse-detail__title class), D-TITLE-SAVE-TRIGGER (blur+Enter commit, Escape revert, dirty-check+guard, allow empty), D-CARET-SAFE (no renderNoteDetail/editorHandle on commit; targeted DOM only; ULID preserved on rename so body saves still route), D-NEW-NOTE-FLOW, D-EMPTY-TITLE-DISPLAY (noteDisplayTitle 'Untitled' in list, placeholder in detail). Top risk R-CARET (P0) guarded by G-TITLE-EDIT-SAVE asserting EditorView+.cm-editor identity. R-RENAME-INTERACTION (P1) guarded by defensive flush + per-field read-modify-write + G-TITLE-RENAME-BODY-SAVE-STILL-WORKS.

expected_response.shape_hint: Land NN-1 before NN-2 (NN-2 focuses the NN-1 input). Empty title is intended and backend-safe (slugify('')='untitled'); show 'Untitled' in the list and a placeholder in the detail input — do NOT force a value. Required harness edits up front: add createNote to the invoke mock+import (test:60-70) and the controller import (notes_controller.ts:44); migrate the detail-title assertion (test:453) from .textContent to .value. Run all gates under Node >= 20 (nvm v24.x; system v16 crashes vitest).

assumptions: create_note accepts title:'' and produces <ULID>--untitled.md (slugify('')='untitled', fs.rs:49-50); edit_note accepts title:'' likewise.

edit_note title-change preserves frontmatter.id (ULID) and renames in the same folder; get_note/body-save route by id via find_note_path, so body autosave keeps working after a rename (ops/notes.rs:81-137,56-59).
renderNoteDetail returning the EditorHandle and exposing getView()/.cm-editor (editor.ts:74,839) lets gates assert no-remount node identity.
